relation_candidates.rationale: The write reaches bundle_state without updating the persistent pre-execution cache, enabling next-block reuse of a cache that lacks the new slot.
The audit states that stale block-hash data from the reused cache causes sequencer and replica executions to produce divergent state roots.

causal_trace.summary: During block N, the attributes thread performs the EIP-2935 storage write outside normal EVM execution by inserting the history-storage account state into execution_results.bundle_state.state.
The out-of-band write updates bundle_state but not pre_execution.cache, so the cache does not represent the post-EIP-2935 state represented by bundle_state.
Because the cache persists across iterations, block N+1 pre-execution reuses the stale cache; a transaction reading the relevant parent block-hash finds slot[N-1] missing and reads stale data.
The audit reports that sequencer and replica execution can produce divergent state roots, resulting in consensus failure and chain halt.

failure.operation: Reuse of a pre-execution cache missing the EIP-2935 slot[N-1] value during next-block transaction pre-execution.

primary_invariant.statement: After an EIP-2935 write performed outside normal EVM execution, pre_execution.cache and bundle_state must represent the same block-hash storage state before the cache is reused for pre-execution.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The reported pipeline.rs insertion writes only execution_results.bundle_state.state; the persistent pre_execution.cache is not updated with the new EIP-2935 block-hash slots.

quality.review_notes: The public audit provides finding-level mechanism, source-location excerpt, trigger condition, impact, recommendation, and a reported PR #876 resolution. No vulnerable repository snapshot, resolvable patch diff, or public e2e test/run result is in this bundle. The report says a modified e2e PoC was shared with developers, but that establishes neither a public harness nor an independently observed execution result.

remediation.invariant_restored: The pre-execution cache's EIP-2935 slots are updated with the new block hashes after the attributes-thread write, aligning the reused cache with bundle_state.
mitigation_classes: synchronize speculative cache after out-of-band state mutation
maintain EIP-2935 storage coherence across execution state representations
